edges.notes: Linux-focused CRI runtime; kubelet integration on Linux nodes.
Implements Kubernetes CRI for kubelet (`src-k8s-cri`, CRI-O docs).
Commonly uses runc (or compatible OCI runtime) underneath; configurable.
CRI-O can use crun as the low-level OCI runtime where configured.
Image pulls from registries use distribution-compatible HTTP semantics.
Executes pod containers as OCI bundles via a low-level OCI runtime implementing the spec.
Alternative CRI implementation class on Linux; not mutually exclusive in knowledge model.
